language.label: Language
language.help: Choose the language of Langdock Sync.
settings.keySet: An API key is saved. Enter a new key to replace it.
settings.keyStorage: The API key is stored in Obsidian SecretStorage.
settings.workspaceKeyHelp: Create a workspace API key with the Knowledge Folder API permission ({scope}) in the {link}.
settings.editorHelp: This list shows the knowledge bases your workspace API key can access. To sync a new base, a workspace admin must grant the key the Editor role under Share. {link}
settings.automaticHelp: Sync on startup and after changes in the vault.
settings.intervalHelp: Sync periodically while the vault is open.
settings.attachmentExtensionsHelp: Select the file extensions to sync. With no extensions selected, attachment sync is off. Each attachment must have a matching entry in its folder’s _meta.md.
settings.noteSyncButtonHelp: Show the Langdock sync status and a sync action in the header of eligible files.
settings.foldersHelp: Add at least one folder and choose a knowledge base for each. Use / for the entire vault. Subfolders inherit the nearest assignment, for example Knowledge/Support can have its own knowledge base.
settings.propertiesLogic: Same property: OR. Different properties: AND.
settings.propertiesExample: Example: `classification` must be `public` or `internal`, and `topic` must be `handbook`.
settings.propertiesHelp: Filters are optional. Manage classifications with {link}.
status.targetsEmpty: No knowledge bases are visible to this API key.
status.syncFailed: Sync failed. See settings for details.

about.description: Sync approved Markdown notes and attachments from Obsidian with Langdock knowledge bases.
about.author: Developed by {author}
intro.title: Introduction to Langdock Sync
intro.connectionHelp: In the Langdock Sync settings, save a workspace API key with the KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER_API scope. Use “{test}” to check access.
intro.scopeHelp: Assign a knowledge base to at least one vault folder. Subfolders inherit the nearest assignment. The default filter is classification: public.
intro.syncHelp: Use “{preview}” to review uploads, updates, and deletions. Then select “{sync}”. Automatic sync starts off and can be enabled in settings.
